purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for five more registered GlobalSaaSHub affiliate-audit targets. Research only; no application, account enrollment, legal acceptance, payment, or new queue UUID is created.

entries.commission: Up to 15% lifetime commission on qualifying referred orders
entries.payout_terms: Monthly payouts; current public affiliate page advertises average revenue per order around $700 but does not expose the payout rail or threshold in the retrieved content.
entries.eligibility: Current public program page provides a direct affiliate join path and promotes sharing Bookyourdata with an audience; no mandatory paid Bookyourdata subscription is stated on the retrieved page.
entries.evidence_summary: Bookyourdata's current official affiliate page confirms an active program with up to 15% lifetime commission, monthly payouts and a 90-day cookie. Unknown payout details are not inferred.

entries.commission: 20% recurring commission on each referred paying customer's eligible subscription payments for the first 12 months
entries.payout_terms: Paid through the affiliate profile at the beginning of the applicable calendar month; a valid up-to-date PayPal account is required by the current Affiliate Program Terms.
entries.eligibility: A Program application is required and Databox must approve it before issuing the unique Affiliate ID/link. Self-referrals involving a company owned by or employing the affiliate are excluded.
entries.legal_consent_note: Databox's current Affiliate Program Terms state that affiliates must agree to the Agreement to participate and receive payment. No application or agreement acceptance was performed.
entries.evidence_summary: Databox's current official Affiliate Program Terms, revised October 2025, confirm an active FirstPromoter/PartnerStack application route, 20% recurring commission for 12 months, a 90-day attribution period and PayPal payout requirements.

entries.commission: Current Partner Program Agreement states 30% recurring on monthly subscriptions while the customer remains subscribed, 30% recurring annually on yearly subscriptions, and a one-time commission for lifetime deals.
entries.payout_terms: Current Partner Agreement states monthly payments after reaching a $50 minimum. The affiliate landing page also lists PayPal/Stripe and describes payment after the grace period; public wording on exact monthly timing differs slightly between sections.
entries.eligibility: The affiliate page encourages everyone to apply and says applications are normally reviewed within three business days, especially welcoming affiliates with agency/freelancer audiences and content channels.
entries.official_wording_note: The affiliate page FAQ contains a narrower phrase saying 30% on the initial purchase, while the current legal Partner Program Agreement explicitly defines recurring 30% monthly/yearly commissions. The legal agreement is recorded as the more specific governing terms, without hiding the first-party wording discrepancy.
entries.legal_consent_note: The current Partner Program Agreement states that joining constitutes agreement to its terms, including independent-contractor, confidentiality, non-competition/non-solicitation and governing-law provisions. No application or acceptance was performed; a later forced acceptance must stop for human approval.
entries.evidence_summary: Taskip has a current active affiliate/partner program. First-party legal terms support 30% recurring commissions and a $50 payout floor, while the public affiliate FAQ has partially inconsistent initial-purchase wording that should be rechecked at actual enrollment.

entries.commission: 20% commission on a new customer's first-subscription revenue for up to 12 months
entries.payout_terms: Accepted creators receive a referral link, discount code and tracking dashboard; exact public payout method, threshold and cadence were not stated on the retrieved official page.
entries.eligibility: Current official page targets AI/automation creators, educators/community builders and affiliate partners; applications are reviewed by Gumloop before acceptance.
entries.evidence_summary: Gumloop's current official Creator Program confirms a live application path and 20% first-year commission for new customers. Missing cookie and payout figures are left unknown rather than guessed.

entries.commission: Flexible recurring revenue share starting from 30%, described by hide.me as lifetime revenue share
entries.payout_terms: Official page advertises fast global payouts and an affiliate dashboard but does not publish a current public payout threshold, rail, or exact cadence in the retrieved text.
entries.eligibility: Current official page invites promotion through websites, blogs, social channels and Google Ads and provides a live affiliate-registration path via Post Affiliate Pro.
entries.evidence_summary: hide.me's current official affiliate page confirms an active Post Affiliate Pro program, recurring/lifetime revenue share starting from 30%, a dedicated affiliate manager and global payout support. Cookie and exact payout mechanics remain unknown from the public page.
